## Summary

Implements #1433 (parent #1427; depends on #1431, #1432).

Adds a checked-in **structured review posture mapping** artifact + validator that maps existing MS `source`/`span`/`raw-item`/`candidate-link` signals into post-attempt review posture, **without overclaiming scoring readiness**.

New files (narrow, additive only):
- `scripts/method-map/build-post-attempt-structured-review-posture.mjs` — pure resolver, artifact builder, validator, readback
- `scripts/method-map/__tests__/post-attempt-structured-review-posture.test.js` — 19 tests
- `artifacts/method-map/v1-9709/post-attempt-structured-review-posture.{v1.json,validator-result.v1.json,readback.md}`

## What it maps

- **structured_mark_point_status**: `accepted` / `provisional` / `candidate_only` / `missing` / `blocked`
- **worked_solution_status**: `accepted` / `provisional` / `fallback_explanation` / `missing` / `blocked`

- Accepted/provisional/candidate/missing/blocked counts reported separately in the summary.

## Scoring boundary (hard rules enforced)

- Candidate/provenance MS evidence **never** becomes accepted scoring truth.
- Provisional/candidate content requires **downgraded wording** and cannot support confident final scoring.

- Missing structured MS still emits a **fallback** review payload and never drops the row.

This mapping artifact **ships no released scoring authority**, so every checked-in case keeps `authoritative_score_allowed` and `point_judgement_allowed` **false** (`authoritative_score_allowed_count = 0`, no `released_deterministic` posture) and makes **no official scoring or Smart Mark readiness claim**. items.title: Fix auth refresh-session revocation on credential changes
items.body:
## Summary

This patches the custom JWT auth flow so credential changes and logout revoke backend refresh sessions instead of leaving old refresh tokens usable.

What changed:
- password change now deletes all `user_sessions` rows for the user before returning success
- password reset now deletes all `user_sessions` rows for the user before returning success
- new `action=logout` verifies a refresh token and deletes only that matching refresh session
- revocation helpers preserve the existing `refresh_token_hash` / `token_hash` fallback behavior
- missing `user_sessions` keeps the existing non-enforced degraded behavior, while real delete failures fail closed

Root cause: password change and reset only updated `user_profiles.password_hash` and cleared reset fields; logout had no backend refresh-token invalidation path.

Access-token behavior is intentionally unchanged. Already-issued stateless access tokens can live until normal expiry; this PR revokes refresh sessions only.
